title: Both payroll employment (+29,000) and unemployment rate (4.2%) change little in September
author: US Bureau of Labor Statistics
summary: Both nonfarm payroll employment (+29,000) and the unemployment rate (4.2 percent) changed little in September. Employment in all major industries changed little over the month.
bodyHtml: Both nonfarm payroll employment (+29,000) and the unemployment rate (4.2 percent) changed little in September. Employment in all major industries changed little over the month.
